equations_to_verify_against_code.clut_row: EDX = SAR32(A90A04,6) - 0x1e0; unsigned EDX > 0x1e becomes row 0; the active CC50 CLUT branch requires [0x96E3E0] != 0 and row != 0
equations_to_verify_against_code.clut_lookup: CC50 palette base = 0x92C390 + (row << 8), with index=source_texel; zero source texel bypasses the lookup/store; nonzero result is written directly to destination
equations_to_verify_against_code.clut_gate_off_fallback: With [0x96E3E0] == 0 and nonzero row, D420 samples raw texel to A90A08 and calls C2E0; C2E0 fills the clipped span from A90A08 without a texel-zero test
equations_to_verify_against_code.clut_conditional_fragment_limit: D420's D5F3 read from 0x92C490 + row*256 + texel is bypassed by the stable gate branches (gate nonzero+row nonzero returns through CC50; gate zero preserves ECX=0 and D5D8 branches to D600); do not treat that fragment as the active CLUT base proof
equations_to_verify_against_code.blend_pixel_index: direct C8F0: (source_texel << 8) | prior_destination_byte; C700 shaded path: (shade_base[source_texel] << 8) | prior_destination_byte

equations_to_verify_against_code.surface_destination: destination row start = *(DWORD*)0xBA0210 + y * *(DWORD*)0xBA0214; pixel index adds clipped x
